regulatory_context.summary: The sweepstakes casino model faced unprecedented state-level crackdowns in 2025. Montana (Oct 2025), New Jersey (Aug 2025), West Virginia (Nov 2025), California (Dec 2025), Delaware (Apr 2025), Mississippi (Jul 2025), Nevada, Connecticut, Maine, Indiana, Tennessee, and Illinois all enacted or enforced restrictions. The dual-currency model is under legal scrutiny nationwide.
